sources.scope: General blood-test education: test description and result interpretation sections; not individual diagnosis.

scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Measures the number of circulating red cells.
high: Dehydration, low-oxygen conditions and increased red-cell production are possible associations.
low: Blood loss, nutritional problems and kidney failure are possible associations.
caveats: Altitude, pregnancy and other blood tests can affect interpretation; a count is not a diagnosis.
